Directions for Questions 96 to 100:
Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:
"The resilience of modern urban ecosystems depends critically on intelligent resource management and
decentralized infrastructure. Urbanization across the globe is accelerating at an unprecedented pace, exerting
intense pressure on municipal water reserves, power grids, and waste processing facilities. Centralized top-down
supply grids frequently falter under acute climate shocks such as prolonged heatwaves and flash floods. By
contrast, decentralized solutions—such as localized rooftop solar microgrids, urban rainwater harvesting, and
circular composting—create redundant, shock-absorbing buffers. Fostering citizen participation in civic maintenance
transforms passive consumers into active stewards of their urban environment."
questions.questionText: According to the author, on what does the resilience of modern urban ecosystems critically depend?
options: Intelligent resource management and decentralized infrastructure
Indefinite expansion of centralized highway systems
Complete privatization of all municipal services
